scripts.ext:build: cargo build --release -p sidecar && node -e "fs.mkdirSync('extension/bin',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('target/release/pushright-engine.exe','extension/bin/pushright-engine.exe');fs.copyFileSync('LICENSE','extension/LICENSE');fs.copyFileSync('THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt','extension/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt');fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/icons/128x128.png','extension/icon.png')" && vite build -c extension/vite.webview.mts && vite build -c extension/vite.host.mts
scripts.ext:package: pnpm ext:build && node -e "for(const f of fs.readdirSync('extension'))if(f.endsWith('.vsix'))fs.rmSync('extension/'+f)" && cd extension && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce package --target win32-x64 --no-dependencies
